soldier: Head reddish yellowish brown, labrum yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown; the flanges over the antennal sockets and antennal segments 1 to 3 reddish brown, becoming paler segment by segment towards the apex; pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule sparsely haired, the setae of the median area of the pronotum about 10. Head capsule somewhat rectangular, the sides slightly contracted at the middle and slightly widened again behind, the posterior lateral angles broad and rounded. Fontanelle flat, almost not raised. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices curved inwards, the outer margin a broad arc. Left mandible about 0.65 times the length of the head capsule and about 1.10 times the greatest width of the head. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 8 marginal bristles. Antennae 12-segmented, segments 1 and 3 almost equal in length, segment 3 about 2.5 times segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad U-shaped median concavity, the posterior margin almost straight at the centre, the median longitudinal line faintly discernible.
